POSTPROC_CFG

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x20
Size:
0x4

Description

Orthogonal bits. 00 raw GEMM | 01 ReLU | 11 ReLU+requant | 10 requant only (logits layer). Requant path is always round-to-nearest + saturate.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:2] - - - -
[1] REQUANT_EN rw 0x0 -
[0] RELU_EN rw 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

REQUANT_EN

Multiply, shift/round, saturate to Q_W. Output lanes become int8 (sign-extended to OUT_W).

RELU_EN

ReLU on accumulator.
